summary: Architecture design for the Gelb cinematic-documentary skill domain. Defines 13 workflows across 4 tiers: Foundation (character, origin, hook), Structure (false victory, scene audit, pacing), Craft (emotion-over-information, editing, coherence), and Process (creative lifecycle). Includes cross-expert stacking chains, workflow detail specifications with input/output contracts, integration points, and the full build checklist for genius.md, SKILL.md, and workflow files.
